description: Financial assistance scheme by the Government of Tamil Nadu for male students from government schools pursuing higher education.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month deposited directly into bank accounts to support purchasing books, study materials, and educational expenses.

eligibility_rules.source: Tamil Nadu Higher Education Department Announcement 2024

eligibility_rules.description: Must be enrolled in recognized higher education courses (UG Degree, Diploma, ITI)
eligibility_rules.source: Tamil Nadu Government Higher Education Guidelines

eligibility_rules.description: Must have studied from Class 6 to Class 12 in Tamil Nadu Government Schools
eligibility_rules.source: Tamil Nadu Higher Education Portal Guidelines

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be a resident of Tamil Nadu

required_documents: Class 10th and 12th Marksheets / School TC showing Govt School attendance from Class 6 to 12
College Bonafide Certificate / Admission ID Card
application_method: Online registration via official Tamil Nadu Higher Education Portal through respective colleges/universities.
source_document: Tamil Nadu Higher Education Department Budget Announcement 2024
